usage.menu.title: Coding usage
usage.details_hint: Click to refresh this source; hover or use Show details to inspect usage
usage.no_reading: No quota reading available. Check the connection in settings.
usage.off_hint: Monitoring is off. Enable it in settings to read selected accounts.
usage.reset_due: Reset time reached · waiting for a new reading
usage.privacy: Off by default. DeepSeek counts local Pi records without contacting Google. Every other selected source checks Google before each usage request and skips it if unreachable. Compatible Pi/tool sign-ins are read-only: no login or credential writes. Gateway keys cannot query subscription quotas. No Keychain access, usage or conversations sent to AI, or Accessibility prompt. Hiding the strip does not disable monitoring.
usage.google_unavailable: Google could not be reached. The usage request was skipped.
usage.copilot.token_billing: Copilot uses token-based billing. This endpoint reported no quota percentage, so no progress ring is shown.
usage.copilot.unlimited: Copilot reported unlimited quotas. There is no percentage limit to draw.
usage.copilot.no_quota: Copilot did not report a usable quota limit or percentage. Unknown usage is not shown as 0%.
usage.spend.unavailable: Local Pi usage could not be read. No account-balance request was made.
usage.spend.no_logs: No Pi session logs found. Check the session directory.
usage.spend.no_records: No DeepSeek billing records identified in the scanned logs.
usage.spend.reference: CC Switch snapshot: 2026-10-08 (V4 peak rates), not a bill.
usage.opacity_hint: Only the background fades; text stays clear. Reduce Transparency uses opaque black.
usage.surface.glass_hint: Original system glass, following macOS Appearance settings. Falls back to solid black on older systems.
usage.surface.darkGlass_hint: Original dark glass: clear glass over a black backing, staying dark in both appearances.
usage.surface.solid_hint: The original black notch, without glass.
usage.polling.original: CodeNotch schedule: 30s while Codex is working, 5 minutes while idle. Looking refreshes at most once per 15s; wake and quota resets also refresh. Server retry delays are respected.
usage.polling.activity: When Codex is selected, reads its local thread metadata and bounded lifecycle records every 2s to detect work. Prompts and responses are not retained or sent anywhere.
usage.refresh_hint: Provider retry delays also apply to manual refresh.
usage.providers_hint: Enabled sources appear left to right in this order. All percentages show used quota.
usage.source.codex: Prefers Pi’s openai-codex subscription OAuth; only an absent entry falls back to ~/.codex/auth.json. Reads official quotas, token statistics and unused resets with CodeNotch display preferences. New openai sign-ins, API keys and gateway keys are not interchangeable. Pi or Codex must renew its own expired login.
usage.codex.title: Codex Usage
usage.codex.sign_in: Sign in to Codex to read your usage
usage.source.claude: Reuses Pi’s anthropic subscription OAuth, read-only, for Claude Pro/Max usage. Ordinary API keys and gateway keys are incompatible. Without a compatible login it stays disconnected; no Keychain access.
usage.source.cursor: Pi authentication cannot replace a Cursor editor login. Reads only the editor’s existing local database; no cursor-agent or Keychain fallback, database writes or token refreshes.
usage.source.copilot: Prefers Pi’s official github-copilot OAuth; only an absent entry falls back to the active github.com oauth_token in gh hosts.yml. No enterprise domains, gh execution, Keychain access or sign-in flow.
usage.source.ollama: Reuses Pi’s ollama Cloud key only with an explicit direct https://ollama.com configuration. Local Ollama, environment variables, commands and gateways are not cloud credentials. Local model chat is unaffected.
usage.source.deepseek: Local Pi estimate. Today's spend / US$100; no shared balance or sign-in required. Uses recorded costs, configured prices, then reference prices.
